name: yaps-image-generate
description: Generate an image from a prompt with Yaps.

interface.longDescription: Generate a PNG from a short prompt with Yaps desktop and its local FLUX.2 [klein] 4B model. The plugin checks the Yaps version, sign-in, trial or Yaps Pro access, and the local Image generation model first, then runs on your computer and writes a new PNG. Optional --sticker also needs the Background Removal model. Apple Silicon with 16 GB or more is required. Requires a local-capable ChatGPT Desktop Work or Codex session; ChatGPT web and cloud sessions cannot reach the installed Yaps engine. Users can also run the feature directly in Yaps.
defaultPrompt: Generate a product photo of a glossy red apple on a white table.
Create an image from this prompt and save a PNG.
